lines.en: Bone feet tread across the frosted ground.
My staff taps down and the frozen soil splits.

lines.zh: 陵外这条路，我走了百年。
lines.en: I have walked this road outside the lair for a century.
Five shadows trail behind me.
Every step measures out your grave.
I do not breathe, so my gait is steady.
Frost hardens into steps beneath my feet.
Patrolling is an old habit of mine.

lines.zh: 谁在陵外走动，我就过去。
lines.en: Whoever walks outside the lair, I go to meet.
My robe hem sweeps by and the grass withers.

lines.zh: 我飘着走，骨头只是架子。
lines.en: I drift along; the bones are only a frame.
This road leads to the gate of the Dread Lair.
Slow down, let the servants keep pace.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，虫都不叫。
lines.en: Where I pass, even the insects fall silent.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的法术痕迹走。
lines.en: I walk along the marks my own spell left.

lines.zh: 仆从在身后，我不用回头。
lines.en: My servants follow behind. I do not look back.
Let me count; five servants still remain.
The bone staff hums in my hand.
The frost soul circles inside my skull.
No heartbeat, and it is rather peaceful.
I remember my own funeral.
Standing too long, my joints creak on their own.
Wind passes through my ribs like a flute.
I left my name behind in the grave.
Two layers of bone plate will hold for a while.

lines.zh: 等一个值得起身的活物。
lines.en: Waiting for a living thing worth rising for.
The thralls turn over in the soil.
Frost settles on my shoulders and does not melt.
A living thing. Warm, and it bleeds.

lines.zh: 让我看看，你的骨头值几分。
lines.en: Let me see what your bones are worth.

lines.zh: 你身上没有悚怖的气味。
lines.en: You do not carry the scent of the Dread.
Your eyes still move. A pity.
I have already measured your height.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我在记你的骨相。
lines.en: Do not blink; I am memorizing your frame.
The sound of your breathing is so loud.
Another one come to die before the lair.

lines.zh: 你身后没有仆从，孤身一人。
lines.en: No servants behind you; you stand alone.

lines.zh: 站直些，我要看清你的锁骨。
lines.en: Stand straight; I want a clear look at your collarbone.
My bones creak, but I have not fallen apart.
That blow knocked a piece off me.
Pain? The dead remember only cold.
My frame closes itself back together.
The plate cracked; the bones remain.
What you shattered was an old shell.
Do not stop; let us see who comes apart first.
That much force cannot bury me.
There is no blood left in the marrow.

lines.zh: 我退一步，是为了再站起来。
lines.en: I step back so I can rise again.
Food? I stopped needing it long ago.
Hand me an apple and it will only freeze solid.
Gold cannot warm bones.
What I feed on is something else.
Put your bread away.

lines.zh: 滋滋作响的肉，与我无关。
lines.en: Sizzling meat has nothing to do with me.
The dead have no appetite.
That smell reminds me of being alive.

lines.zh: 献祭该用骨头，不是粮食。
lines.en: Offerings should be bone, not grain.
I will note your kindness in my ledger.
You bumped me; the bones will rattle.
Step back, do not touch my staff.
You crushed one of my toes.
The warmth of the living is such a nuisance.
Make way, my servants are coming through.
My robe will not survive being tugged.
You knocked half my ribs loose.
Steady yourself, do not tread on the ashes.
In such a hurry, off to be reborn?
One touch and the chill clings to you.
The dead do not marry; we form ranks.
My consort is this lair.
The Queen reigns above; I have no mind for this.
Nothing is born between corpses.
Do not bring the customs of the living here.
I wed death once; that was enough.
This frame passes on no bloodline.
The Dread continue through summoning.

lines.zh: 你问这个，是想要个尸奴？
lines.en: Asking that, do you want to be a thrall?
Desire rotted away with the flesh.
Bones fallen on the ground belong to me.
I keep the shards for building walls.
Gold coins? I use them to level a table.
This key should have stayed in the lair.
I can lift my staff; I need no help.

lines.zh: 我捡起的是仆从的零件。
lines.en: What I pick up are my servants' spare parts.
Do not toss things at my feet.

lines.zh: 碎片越攒越多，墙也高了。
lines.en: The shard pile grows, and so does the wall.
Pick it up and count it as your gift.
My hands touch only bone.
You can fly? Then you die first.
The frost soul has already locked onto you.
Everything that breathes is an enemy.
You are not of the Dread. Halt.
The skull is away; do not hide.
You are marked. Run.
Targets in high places suit me best.
Your pulse gives you away.
One servant summoned is enough for you.

lines.zh: 猎物名单上，多了个名字。
lines.en: A name has been added to the prey list.
Step into the lair's bounds and you will not leave.
I kill you first, then collect your bones.
The skull turns corners; you cannot dodge it.
Fly higher and you will only fall harder.

lines.zh: 你的步子，一声声数得清。
lines.en: I count every step you take, one by one.
The frost soul is behind you.
Back away further and you back into a grave.
Whichever way you turn, I see it.
Do not expect a tree to stop it.
This chill has fixed on you.

lines.zh: 我抬手，你就该知道结局。
lines.en: When I raise my hand, you know the ending.
Struggle; it makes your trail clearer.
Servants on both sides; the road is closed.
The faster you go, the tighter the skull follows.
The staff falls and freezes your shoulder.
This hand of mine is colder than ice.
One blow and your flesh goes stiff.
Do not come close; I need no blade.
The staff head rings against your armor.
My strength comes from grave soil.
One grasp and your warmth scatters.
This blow is struck for the lair gate.
Bone against bone; that is fair.
Back off, I am raising my hand.
The lair gate opens and I walk out.
The frost arrives first, then I do.
Five servants crawl up from the soil.
The wind here knows me.
I have stood here through many winters.
The staff lands first, then I do.
Outside the Dread Lair there is just room for me.
Who woke me from my long sleep?
The chill spreads and the living scatter.
I reassemble myself from the grave soil.
Fire? I only fear it melting my frost.

lines.zh: 摔下来，骨头归位得慢些。
lines.en: After a fall, the bones settle back slowly.
Water fills my ribs; it does weigh me down.

lines.zh: 炸散了我，拼起来要费些时候。
lines.en: You scattered me; reassembling will take a while.

lines.zh: 箭卡在肋骨间，拔掉就是。
lines.en: An arrow is stuck between my ribs; I will pull it out.

lines.zh: 你的法术，撞在我的旧咒上。
lines.en: Your spell struck my old curse.
Hungry? I do not even have a stomach.
Lightning ran over my frame and the frost glows brighter.
The void? I already sleep in the earth.
